purpose: Secret lifecycle metadata only; secret material is never recorded here.
value_policy: Values, private keys, bearer tokens, cookies, passwords, and ciphertext are prohibited.

entries.storage_boundary: DreamHost private broker directory; never public web root or desktop
entries.lifetime: until upstream rotation or account retirement
entries.rotation_path: replace private broker configuration through authenticated deployment
entries.revocation_path: revoke upstream account/session and remove private configuration
entries.evidence: deployment receipt plus private operator verification; no value capture
entries.fail_closed: upstream request denied and generic error returned when absent or invalid
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: DreamHost private broker configuration and operator secret manager; never repository or client
entries.lifetime: short operational lifetime; rotate on operator or host compromise
entries.rotation_path: generate replacement server-side and update private config
entries.revocation_path: remove old key and verify admin routes deny it
entries.evidence: HTTP denial for old key and private deployment record
entries.fail_closed: token administration denies missing, stale, or mismatched key
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: hashed in private broker SQLite; raw value transient at issue and client credential store
entries.lifetime: explicit expiry, bounded by broker policy
entries.revocation_path: broker token revoke route and account/session revocation
entries.fail_closed: unknown, expired, revoked, or malformed token is denied
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: Windows Credential Manager private key; public metadata may be published
entries.lifetime: until key replacement or trust withdrawal
entries.use_path: word-count publisher and broker signature verification
entries.rotation_path: generate new key, publish new public metadata, overlap only during documented transition
entries.revocation_path: remove trusted public key and reject old key id
entries.evidence: signature denial with retired key id and public metadata hash
entries.fail_closed: unsigned, unknown-key, or invalid payload is rejected
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: GitHub Actions protected secret or ephemeral CI memory; never repository
entries.lifetime: protected push or until trust rotation
entries.creation_path: protected CI secret provisioning or explicit ephemeral generation
entries.use_path: release manifest signing and desktop verification
entries.rotation_path: replace protected private key and ship matching public trust metadata
entries.revocation_path: remove old CI secret and reject its public key/hash
entries.evidence: manifest verification failure for retired key plus protected CI audit
entries.fail_closed: mismatched, unsigned, or untrusted manifest is denied
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: GitHub protected secret and local SSH agent/key store; never repository
entries.lifetime: until host/key rotation or CI trust change
entries.use_path: scoped SSH deployment and remote verification

entries.revocation_path: remove authorized key and CI secret; verify BatchMode denial
entries.evidence: remote authenticated identity and old-key denial without key material
entries.fail_closed: deployment aborts when identity, host key, or destination verification fails
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.rotation_path: install replacement mirror key and known-hosts data
entries.revocation_path: remove old mirror key and verify mirror push denial
entries.evidence: host-key verification and authenticated mirror status
entries.fail_closed: mirror job refuses unknown host or missing key
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: GitHub protected secrets and private broker monitor configuration
entries.lifetime: until monitor account rotation or decommission
entries.rotation_path: replace account secret in protected stores
entries.revocation_path: disable account and remove protected secret; verify monitor denial
entries.evidence: monitor denial and broker audit without credential fields

entries.storage_boundary: private environment file / protected deployment secret; never repository or web root
entries.lifetime: until backup key rotation or retention horizon
entries.rotation_path: new key plus retained decrypt window for retained backups
entries.revocation_path: retire key after retention and prove old backups are unavailable
entries.evidence: encryption/decryption test metadata only; no plaintext backup
entries.fail_closed: backup export or restore aborts on missing/short/invalid key
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains

entries.storage_boundary: public application source; public values are not secrets
entries.rotation_path: add replacement pin with bounded overlap
entries.revocation_path: remove retired pin after validated replacement
entries.evidence: pinned positive, retired-pin negative, and TLS-chain validation tests
entries.fail_closed: empty, expired, or untrusted pin set denies protected update requests
entries.deletion_path: remove retired material from its private store and verify no repository, build, log, or public-web copy remains
